predictions.rationale: Primary REST controller exposing endpoints to query and manipulate catalog items, brands, types and pictures; directly implements the Catalog feature.
Domain model representing a product in the catalog; central to storing and retrieving catalog information.
Entity-Framework DB context containing CatalogItem, CatalogBrand and CatalogType sets; persists catalog data and stock.
Configures CatalogItem persistence (table mapping, fields, constraints); refines how catalog data is stored.
Seeds initial catalog brands, types, items and pictures into the database; supports catalog initialization.
gRPC service exposing catalog operations to other micro-services; alternate transport layer for Catalog feature.
Publishes integration events (e.g., price changes, stock updates) originating from catalog changes; supports distributed catalog consistency.
Domain model for catalog brands, an essential facet of catalog management.
Domain model for catalog item types; part of organizing and querying catalog information.
Front-end service that queries the Catalog micro-service and feeds catalog data to the storefront UI; directly supports catalog display to users.
